purpose: M03 second seam-locked transition: entry underpass to deep underpass

exact_shared_pixels.rule: The next panel begins with a byte-for-byte copy of the prior panel's ending.

foreground_transition.purpose: A close, transparent concrete pillar covers the first non-shared background pixels. It is a foreground Pixi layer behind character sprites.

implementation: Place the next panel 520 pixels after the prior panel origin, render only one of the 760 shared pixels, then put the foreground pillar at the recorded location.
